# Report - video28 (L1 proxy, Three.js sampled-frame baseline)

Representation: L1 / Proxy, Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not equivalent to Blender rankings).

Observed from the 24 reference samples: a first-person (game-style) walkthrough. 0.0 s grey riveted room facing an open doorway into a teal-lit room (dead orange creature on its floor), large SMG held at right; by 0.9 s the view passes the door jamb holding a pistol. 1.8-4.5 s teal lower level: two barrels against a wall, a corridor turning left, a free-standing pillar block. 5.45-6.35 s looking up a ladder through a ceiling hatch. 7.27-8.17 s at ladder top, eye just above the upper floor: corridor with four tall gas cylinders behind a red DANGER barrier, a standing zombie on the left and two headcrabs on the floor. 9.08 s explosion of the cylinders (ammo count drops 15->13, i.e. two shots). 9.98-10.9 s view back down/up the ladder shaft. 11.8-13.6 s back at top: cylinders and creatures gone, debris and yellow splats on the floor. 14.5 s turn right into a side corridor. 15.4-16.35 s a scientist sits on the floor in the end alcove, camera approaches and looks down at him. 17.25 s he has stood up (camera very close, looking down). 18.17-19.98 s he stands facing the camera. 20.88 s camera has backed off to the alcove entrance.

Geometry: rooms, corridors, pillar, ladder (rails + rungs + top hand-rail arches), barrels, gas cylinders, barrier, ceiling lights built from boxes/cylinders with flat Lambert colours (grey-blue start room, teal lower level, light blue-grey upper level, brown-grey floors). Scientist: articulated proxy (pelvis, torso with blue shirt/red tie panel, head + white hair, thighs/shins/shoes, upper arms/forearms/hands) with an analytic sit-to-stand transition (16.5-17.15 s). Zombie: articulated proxy with claws; headcrabs as flattened spheres with legs. Weapons are camera-attached proxies: SMG lowers 0-0.4 s, pistol raises 0.35-0.75 s, recoil at the two shots (8.62, 8.84 s).

Camera: single continuous first-person shot (no cuts), vertical FOV 74 deg, Hermite-interpolated keyframes at the sample times (position, yaw, pitch) with eye height 1.6 m (about 1.1 m at the ladder top).

Timing/inference: explosion at 8.95 s (between 8.17 and 9.08 samples; flash sphere, ballistic debris that lands and stays, zombie blown back and removed by 9.4 s, headcrabs removed at blast). The ladder descent/re-ascent 9.1-11.8 s, the walking paths between samples, the stand-up timing and the room layout between viewpoints are inferred. HUD and watermark are not reproduced.

Feedback: none received yet (initial round).

rounds.reason: Re-fit lower-level layout and camera framing, scientist alcove distance and sitting pose, explosion aftermath, and weapon proxies to round-1 feedback.
